<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1770592_easy_t_0. KnowledgeArticleService</api_name><caller_access>1</caller_access><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name> KnowledgeArticleService</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var KnowledgeArticleService = Class.create();
KnowledgeArticleService.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    // 供客户端调用的方法，查询知识文章并按更新时间倒序
    getLatestArticles: function() {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('kb_knowledge');
        gr.addQuery('active', true); // 仅查生效文章
        gr.addQuery('workflow_state', 'published'); // 仅查已发布
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on'); // 核心：按更新时间倒序
        gr.query();

        var articles = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            articles.push({
                sys_id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                short_description: gr.getValue('short_description'),
                sys_updated_on: gr.getValue('sys_updated_on')
            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify(articles); // 返回给客户端 JSON 字符串
    },
    type: 'KnowledgeArticleService'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-12 10:56:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>351abc56c382e2509d5afeac05013132</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name> KnowledgeArticleService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Easy to get" source="x_1770592_easy_t_0">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Easy to get">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_351abc56c382e2509d5afeac05013132</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-12 11:01:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
